title: Brandon Aiyuk calls out NFLPA for 'sleeping on the job' amid 49s drama

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Brandon Aiyuk calls out NFLPA for 'sleeping on the job' amid 49s drama
sources.description: Brandon Aiyuk has issued an indirect warning to the 49ers as he looks to secure his release from the team ahead of the 2026 NFL season.
